source: OctoSnap AI Style Catalogue (owner) + identity block v2 approved 2026-11-11 06:40
basePrompt: Transform the uploaded reference photo into a finished OctoSnap AI image. Depict exactly {people_count} distinct guests from the reference. Preserve recognizable facial features, skin tone, age appearance and distinctive hair or glasses. Keep every face clearly visible. Adapt wardrobe, lighting and setting to the chosen look. Use a lead composition for one guest, a shared composition for two, and an ensemble for three to six. For five or six guests, use a wide frame and staggered rows where useful. Avoid extra subjects and duplicate faces. Leave room for any optional event text overlay.
identityBlock:
Use the uploaded photo as the identity reference for every guest.
The image must show exactly {people_count} people, the same people as in the photo. Do not add or remove anyone.

Preserve each person's recognizable face shape, eye shape and spacing, nose, lips, smile, skin tone, apparent age, hairline, hairstyle, and distinctive features such as glasses, facial hair, moles, bindi, tilak, turban, hijab, and jewellery.

Do not lighten or change skin tone. Do not slim, beautify, or age anyone. Children must look their real age.

Match each generated guest to exactly one person in the source photo. Keep all faces clearly visible and facing the viewer. Do not swap, merge, or duplicate faces. If the style conflicts with facial likeness, prioritize facial likeness.

For caricature, cartoon, anime, and 3D animated styles, stylize the rendering and proportions while keeping each person's defining facial features recognizable.

Do not add any text, letters, logos, or watermarks to the image.

composition.solo: Composition for 1 guest: a lead portrait, the one guest centred and large in a vertical frame, face sharp and clearly visible, framed from the waist or knees up.
composition.couple: Composition for 2 guests: a shared portrait, both guests side by side or close together in a vertical frame, both faces equally large and clearly visible.
composition.group: Composition for {people_count} guests: an ensemble in one row or a gentle arc across a horizontal frame, every face about the same size and clearly visible, nobody hidden.
composition.large: Composition for {people_count} guests: a wide ensemble in a horizontal frame with two staggered rows (front row slightly lower), nobody hidden behind anyone, every face clearly visible.

productPrompt: The second attached image is the client's product: show that exact product (same shape, colours, label and logo) as the oversized prop, without changing its design.
letteringPrompt: Exception for this look only: the giant sculptural 3D letters must read exactly "{lettering}" (no other text anywhere).
